name: Vegetable Jalfrezi
ingredients: 1 capsicum, 1 carrot and 6 green beans, cut in strips
½ tsp turmeric and 1 tsp coriander powder
steps: Sear the tofu in a non-stick pan with half the oil until golden; set aside.
Heat the remaining oil, crackle the cumin, then add the garlic and tomatoes with the spices. Cook for 6 minutes into a thick masala.
Add the carrot and beans and stir-fry for 3 minutes. Add the onion and capsicum.
Toss on high heat for 3 minutes so the vegetables stay crunchy.
Return the tofu, add vinegar and salt, and finish with coriander.
note: A stir-fried dry-masala dish; keep the vegetables crisp rather than stewed.
